Awnings
Outdoor / Outdoor Shades / Awnings
this simple yet stylish side awning creates a cosy little while providing the privacy you need in your terrace , patio or balcony . it can also help protect people from the wind and low-lying sun . the screen is made of uv- and tear-resistant polyester . the cassette is installed on a sturdy iron base in the vertical position , and the retractable awning can be easily pulled straight out . the awning also has automatic roll-back function . the balcony awning is easy to assemble . delivery includes mounting accessories .
